claim_summary: EvoTS-Agent uses curated EDA and validation-guided trajectory evolution to select, revise, and synthesize financial time-series change-point detection pipelines.

claim_evidence.quote: We propose EvoTS-Agent, a validation-guided self-evolving LLM agent for autonomous financial time-series change-point detection. EvoTS-Agent first performs curated exploratory data analysis to characterize dataset properties and initialize candidate detection models.

modules.name: Change-point detector bank
modules.scope_reason: The bank supplies detection algorithms for a specific change-point objective; if the task family changes, the detector set and its output semantics must be redesigned, so R3_1 selects TSK.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - change-point detectors directly implement the task output

evidence.quote: We build a comprehensive model bank, containing a diverse collection of change-point detection methods with fundamentally different assumptions, enabling the agent to handle a broad spectrum of change-point scenarios.
Our model bank integrates eight complementary change-point detection methods.

modules.name: Change-sensitive EDA and detector selection
modules.scope_reason: The procedure computes change-sensitive features and selects candidate change-point models; its logic embeds the change-point task, so a different task family would require redesign under R3_1.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - change-sensitive features and detector selection target change-point detection
R4:Tools and Execution; Planning and Orchestration

evidence.quote: The resulting meta features, an unlabeled time-series visualization, task metadata, and candidate model descriptions are provided to an LLM-based selector. The selector chooses K primary models for warm-up experiments and up to two alternatives.

modules.name: Validation-controlled trajectory evolution
modules.scope_reason: Validation scores govern revision, exploration, recombination, and incumbent selection for change-point pipelines. Because the selection objective is change-point validation performance, changing task family requires redesign, so R3_1 selects TSK.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - trajectory actions and selection are governed by the change-point validation objective
R4:Memory and Context; Planning and Orchestration; Optimization and Evolution

evidence.quote: EvoTS-Agent uses validation outcomes to control the evolutionary process: it revises the incumbent by default, activates an alternative strategy when revision stagnates, and performs evidence-based recombination for final synthesis. Thus, empirical feedback determines not only which solution is retained, but also how the subsequent search is conducted.

process_validity.quote: Finally, Success Rate reports the percentage of runs that complete successfully without execution or runtime failures, reflecting the reliability of each autonomous agent in producing executable solutions.

temporal_validity.quote: Following [11, 20], each dataset is split chronologically into training (60%), validation (20%), and test (20%) sets.

task_performance.quote: We evaluate detection quality using four complementary metrics. F1 is the primary metric and is computed using boundary-aware matching between predicted and ground-truth change points within a predefined ±10-sample tolerance window, balancing precision and recall.

changes: dimensions: replace retired Control, Verification, and Feedback with Planning and Orchestration
reconciliation.reason: The trajectory operators are triggered and selected using change-point validation scores, and incumbent selection optimizes the change-point task objective; changing the task requires redesigning that procedure.

changes: separated detector-bank integration from EDA-based model selection
dimension: Planning and Workflow->Planning and Orchestration
reconciliation.reason: The paper explicitly contributes a detector bank and a curated EDA selector as independently usable mechanisms; the bank integrates eight change-point methods while EDA chooses candidate models from dataset features.

notes: Change-point detection is recorded as an explicit other task because the paper evaluates locating structural changes, not downstream decision utility. The existing card's anomaly-detection family mapping is narrowed to the paper's stated change-point task.
